purpose: Complete the fixed E01-E20 V170 low-load training cohort without rerunning E09, E18, or E20, then apply the unchanged full-cohort throughput and QPR gates exactly once.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

checks: exact remaining17 seed product and fixed order with no diagnostic seed or baseline rerun
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing for all seventeen new runs
the run_config and every window retain the frozen V170 concurrency, CPU, short-work and queue boundaries
each active window has heavy count strictly above two and each inactive window has count at or below two
every rejected heavy terminal player is rejected only in an active window and has normalized CPU strictly above one
parents-completed heavy players bypass the terminal guard
both placement-router branches and all short-work queue/work invariants are audited across the combined twenty-run cohort
the sealed diagnostic blind audit remains byte-identical and contributes E09, E18 and E20 mechanism evidence
zero throughput, completion, latency, cost or QPR fields are parsed before the blind audit is sealed

full_cohort_selection_rule.evaluation: Combine the seventeen new V170 rows with the sealed V170 E09, E18 and E20 rows, yielding exactly one retained row for each E01-E20 seed.
full_cohort_selection_rule.throughput_mean_gate: strictly greater than frozen Orion 1.4741 requests/ms
full_cohort_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 positive paired differences against Orion
full_cohort_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both finite-only and zero-completed-as-zero QPR means strictly greater than frozen OCS 0.055577160345697
full_cohort_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 positive paired differences against OCS with all 20 finite-only values
full_cohort_selection_rule.joint_pass: all three unchanged metric gates and the result-blind mechanism audit pass
full_cohort_selection_rule.success: freeze the complete V170 E01-E20 NSESche low-load cohort as the closed homogeneous 20-node low result and authorize a separately committed downstream reuse/export plan
full_cohort_selection_rule.failure: retain all twenty valid V170 runs without deletion or selective rerun, keep homogeneous low open, and require a new result-informed causal plan before any further NSESche experiment
full_cohort_selection_rule.paper_claim_on_training_success: none until a separately frozen confirmation or final-data boundary is committed
